290: 		case WorkflowCallEventInputTypeNumber:
291: 			t = NumberType{}
292: 		case WorkflowCallEventInputTypeString:
293: 			t = StringType{}
294: 		}

300: 	}

304: 			Name: o.Name.Value,
305: 		}
306: 	}

311: 			Required: r,
312: 			Name:     s.Name.Value,
313: 		}

323: func parseReusableWorkflowMetadata(src []byte) (*ReusableWorkflowMetadata, error) {
324: 	type workflow struct {
325: 		On yaml.Node `yaml:"on"`
326: 	}
327: 
328: 	var w workflow
329: 	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(src, &w); err != nil {
330: 		return nil, err // Unreachable
331: 	}
332: 
333: 	n := &w.On
334: 	if n.Line == 0 && n.Column == 0 {
335: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf("\"on:\" is not found")
336: 	}
337: 
338: 	switch n.Kind {
339: 	case yaml.MappingNode:
340: 		// on:
341: 		//   workflow_call:
342: 		for i := 0; i < len(n.Content); i += 2 {
343: 			k := strings.ToLower(n.Content[i].Value)
344: 			if k == "workflow_call" {
345: 				var m ReusableWorkflowMetadata
346: 				if err := n.Content[i+1].Decode(&m); err != nil {
347: 					return nil, err
348: 				}
349: 				return &m, nil
350: 			}
351: 		}
352: 	case yaml.ScalarNode:
353: 		// on: workflow_call
354: 		if v := strings.ToLower(n.Value); v == "workflow_call" {
355: 			return &ReusableWorkflowMetadata{}, nil
356: 		}
357: 	case yaml.SequenceNode:
358: 		// on: [workflow_call]
359: 		for _, c := range n.Content {
360: 			e := strings.ToLower(c.Value)
361: 			if e == "workflow_call" {
362: 				return &ReusableWorkflowMetadata{}, nil
363: 			}
364: 		}
365: 	}
366: 
367: 	return nil, fmt.Errorf("\"workflow_call\" event trigger is not found in \"on:\" at line:%d, column:%d", n.Line, n.Column)
368: }
